doc.selection: all remaining registered-source-disjoint documents in existing stable source hash order; original independent page hash; first6 numeric question IDs
doc.proposed_cohort: Use all 54 as one final small fresh Doc cohort after method freeze; no tuning on these sources
doc.limitation: fresh against enumerated TrajKV identities; unrelated earlier project exposure is not exhaustively known

text.selection: first256 fixed salted source-ID hashes from audited exclusion union; lowest numeric questionId per image; first192 is a nested fallback
text.proposed_cohort: Prefer one fixed Text256 cohort for transfer; Text192 is a prespecified resource fallback, not a score-driven choice
text.freeze_rule: freeze methods/rankings/gains only on Doc development before staging/inference; do not calibrate on Text
text.metric: official ten-annotator TextVQA soft accuracy; annotations remain separate local files
